$comment: Single source of truth for the models the skill-evaluation infra runs against and how a judge is chosen. Consumed by resolve-judge.mjs, which the evaluation and vally-evaluation workflows and eng/vally-adapter/run-vally-evals.sh call. Bump the IDs here (verified against the CI Copilot token's ListModels output) to roll models forward everywhere at once.
$comment_gating: Agent model used for PR (gating) skill-validator runs. Kept to a single model for stable, comparable-to-history gating. Judge is still resolved via the judge rules below so the judge is never the same model as the agent.
$comment_matrix: Agent models used for non-gating (nightly/scheduled) skill-validator runs and for all vally runs. Each is judged by the model resolved from the rules below.
$comment_judge: Judge selection: the judge defaults to defaultJudge (latest Opus). When the agent model IS the defaultJudge (or otherwise appears in judgeOverrides), the override is used so a model never judges itself. Every resolved judge is asserted to differ from the agent model.
